findings.description: Footer is left in English on the French page.
Uses informal tu/tes while the title and rest of the site use vous.
"Appliquer pour" is an anglicism in Quebec French.

findings.observed: /static/img/banner-en.png ("Financing that fits your plans / Competitive rates. Clear terms. No surprises.")
findings.expected: Serve a French banner image (e.g. banner-fr.png)
findings.description: French page uses the English banner image with English text embedded.
Empty full name on the French form shows the English required message while other fields show French.

findings.observed: Merci. Votre demande pour {montant} a été reçue.
findings.expected: Merci. Votre demande pour 12 500,00 $ a été reçue.
findings.description: The amount placeholder {montant} is shown literally instead of the formatted amount.
Section heading left in English on the French dashboard.
Transaction dates in French use US MM/DD/YYYY order (09/15/2026, 09/12/2026, 09/08/2026), which is ambiguous and not Canadian French convention.
In French, zero takes the singular form.
"Balance" is an anglicism for an account balance; French uses "solde".
"Statement" (bank statement) mistranslated as "déclaration" (which suggests a tax or formal declaration).
The French dashboard link points to the English calculator page, switching language.
Monthly payment uses English currency format instead of Canadian French (comma decimal, trailing $ after a space).
"Pay later" translated as "Payer maintenant" (pay now), the opposite meaning, and contradicts the help text about deferral.

findings.observed: Aucune accusation pour un remboursement anticipé.
findings.expected: Aucuns frais pour un remboursement anticipé.
findings.description: "Charges" rendered as "accusation" (criminal accusation) instead of fees ("frais").

findings.expected: Taux variable de 5,2 %, sous réserve de l'approbation du crédit.
findings.description: French drops the condition "subject to credit approval".

findings.expected: Use the French variant of the same promo (variable rate 5,2 %), with matching alt text
findings.description: The French promo image displays a different offer (fixed rate 4.9%) than the alt text and the page (variable rate 5.2%).
"Close" translated as "Proche" (near/close by) instead of the verb "Fermer".
